plan.purpose: Bounded nonlinear full7s trajectory search after the local linear combination failed physical validation; feasibility diagnostic, not trained policy acceptance
plan.preparation: Every case independently executes original6.5s reach/manual release/frozen7s grasp; search and identical replay require exact parent physical/controller/camera/RNG/model signature. No snapshots, velocity clearing, retries or successful-prefix filtering
plan.trajectory: Two16D position offsets relative to the actual prefix-end controller command, each bounded +/-0.18rad and clipped to original ROM; quintic interpolation through2.5s and5s, then hold final target to7s. Convert position error to original16D velocity actions using current controller command; retain braking velocity, acceleration, delay and invalid-observation behavior
plan.selection: Fixed CEM5x32 with8 elites, independent optimizer RNG, best-so-far retained as candidate0, sigma=max(elite std,0.012); begin with one zero-offset reference. Score only this search state; freeze selected offsets before any of3 replays, which never update selection
plan.cost: Final20ticks mean: (fullSO3deg/15)^2 +0.05min((v/.015)^2,100)+0.05min((w/.3)^2,100)+2*(not loaded opposition)+0.1*(handoff displacement/.01)^2; plus0.01mean((offset/.18)^2). Incomplete/failed/command-invalid cases add10000. Native full-task success subtracts100, without changing native gates
plan.constraints: All original2ms penetration<=2mm, normal force<=10weights, release-origin displacement<4cm, excluded support, numerical, vision and drop checks. Controller speed<=.8rad/s, acceleration<=2rad/s^2, ROM, fixed neutral wrist; preserve inherited prefix controller velocity
plan.success: Unmodified PenRotateEnv15deg/140ticks, final continuous1s fullSO3<8deg, loaded opposing thumb/middle, low actual velocities, spans<2deg and2mm. Search success is not independent100-case or continuous-rotation acceptance
plan.logging: Keep every candidate, including all aborts, with full296D deployable pre-action observations,16D actions, controller commands, truth scoring and contact records; per-case immutable files plus atomic progress index
plan.scope: One positive direction and one search state only. Transfer seeds were previously seen development states, not fresh formal evidence. No formal2611 reuse, no training or hardware actions; no automatic budget extension

selected_final_1s_posthoc.purpose: Posthoc native-gate diagnosis only; does not relabel the failed trajectory
